perspective:
Jose Castillo has access to the following information:

- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual at work and remembered her as normally vibrant.
- He asked if she was okay, and she said it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff.” She thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and she said she appreciated it.
- He overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He brought up financial planning and budgeting with her, and she said she had been feeling overwhelmed with her bills.
- She thanked him and said she would take him up on the offer to talk about budgeting tips.
- He later worried he might have overstepped by bringing up finances, so he clarified that he only wanted to help, not pry.
- Patricia told him she didn’t think he was prying and that she was grateful for his help.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend; she said it meant a lot to know she had someone to turn to.
- After that, he sensed she appreciated his concern but preferred to handle her issues privately.
- He checked in with her casually about weekend plans; she said she was fine and planning a quiet weekend at home.
- He continued to offer support, and Patricia said she was busy but handling things, thanked him for checking in, and said his support meant a lot.
- He responded that he was happy to help and that they were all there for each other.
